intervention_definition: Matched restoration uses the restoration delta for the method-predicted control; mismatched restoration uses the other control restoration delta.
operational_label_definition: Operational dominant control is whichever restoration has the larger clipped NDCG@10 loss reduction: S3 full history vs truncated history for the user-history control, and S5 original item text vs ablated item text for the item-content control. This is a constructed diagnostic label, not a causal source.
response_prediction_definition: If a UQ method provides finite source_scores.user and source_scores.item, those source scores are used directly. Otherwise, predicted control-response scores are scalar uncertainty increases under S3 history truncation and S5 item-field ablation relative to their corresponding restored controls.
